verdict.rationale: The Mesh API covers a broad set of UI functions: cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either in the web app or via the API. Documented endpoints also cover customer monitoring configuration, exports, case audit trails, roles, transaction processing and customer lookup, all backed by a published OpenAPI schema. However, API credentials must be generated in the web app, and no parity statement or endpoint is shown for configuring screening or risk-scoring setups. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity guarantee, API-based credential and access management, API configuration of screening configurations and risk-score equations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
This endpoint allows you to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer.
Create a new export by selecting an export type and a start and end date.
The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials
